title: 扩展心理治疗督导：用大语言模型评估心理治疗保真度
summary: 该研究提出基于大语言模型的集成应用，自动完成心理治疗保真度评估流程，并从真实长程临床转录文本生成可操作的督导反馈。研究比较三种开源模型及多种任务分解与推理策略，发现证据优先推理可提升保真度估计；在独立随机对照试验中验证了外部构念效度，能可靠区分CBT与非CBT会话；专家用户研究认为反馈具有临床可操作性。
summary_en: This work presents an integrated LLM application that automates psychotherapy fidelity assessment and generates actionable supervisory feedback from authentic long-form clinical transcripts. Evaluating three open-weight models across task decompositions and reasoning strategies, it shows evidence-first reasoning improves fidelity estimation, establishes external construct validity on an independent RCT by distinguishing CBT from non-CBT sessions, and finds experts rate the generated feedback as clinically actionable.
